description.value:
You charge a willing creature's cells with extra chakra, accelerating their healing factor for a short window.

The target gains fast healing 5 for 1 minute (or until you Dismiss the jutsu). The target also recovers from drained, enfeebled, and clumsy conditions at twice the normal rate. The target is fatigued for 1 hour after this jutsu ends (the cellular debt comes due).

Heightened (7th) Fast healing increases to 10; the post-effect fatigue duration drops to 10 minutes.
